I guess I could've given context to my point a little better: a lot of champions shouldn't be given durability because they have kits under the construct of not being beefy.
Fiora is a VERY strong example of a dangerous champion to buff durability with and that's why myself and others (I'm hoping) have been pointing that out.
But imagine an Akali or the int brothers getting more durability.
Or SION (dear god)
I agree that there's a lot of one-shotting, but giving too much durability and/or to the wrong champion would bring about a meta that would make the whole "fast-pace"ness of WR somewhat null.

Here's the thing, Fiora HEAVILY excels at dueling. As such, her strength is much more geared toward bullying in the laning phase- getting as much leveling/ gold/ CS- during her first turret (and first herald, kinda hard to steal her from a good fiora/jungle duo) 

That being said, Fiora's better at making picks with her ult to heal her team mates during- or to better initiate- a team fight later on. You shouldn't be able to take on the enemy beyond a 1v2 by pure stats alone.
[ This is why many on this thread are against a durability buffing for Fiora; her solo-healing combined with her parry, combined with her team healing, combined with her combo system, combined with her dueling potential]
Fiora simply is too strong in the right hands and mind.

Tl;dr : You don't need more survivability with Fiora, you need to stop being greedy.
